name: garden-lambda-facebook-share
description: V4-FBSHARE-001 — Facebook Page sharing. POST /api/share/facebook: Clerk-authed, ADMIN_CLERK_SUBS-gated, household-scoped. Reads photo bytes from S3, strips EXIF, byte-uploads to the Graph API (single /photos, or published=false + /feed attached_media for multi), records to share_log for idempotency + orphan cleanup. Kill switch FB_SHARE_ENABLED. Pure helpers (exif.js/graph.js) unit-test without runtime deps; mirrors lambda/harvests.
